name: cockpit
description: Session cockpit: a band above the prompt, a detail pane, a line under each reply

language.title: Language
language.description: The cockpit's language; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system

band.title: Band
band.description: Show the band above the prompt

pillContext.title: Band: context pill
pillContext.description: Context size, weather and the last prompts' bars

pillCache.title: Band: cache pill
pillCache.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm

plan.title: Plan progress
plan.description: Show Claude's task list as a progress bar

planTool.title: Plan tool
planTool.description: Give Claude a progress tool for plans in stages, one bar each (costs a few hundred tokens per request)

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: Open the detail pane beside the chat

paneRings.title: Pane: rings
paneRings.description: Context, 5h and 7d rings at the top of the pane

paneRepo.title: Pane: repository card
paneRepo.description: Branch, commits and changes of the git repository

tabFiles.title: Pane: Files tab
tabFiles.description: The files the session changed and read

tabHistory.title: Pane: History button
tabHistory.description: A 🕘 button: a small card with the last turns, and the whole history as a tab

replyLine.title: Reply line
replyLine.description: Show a line of figures under each reply

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.description: Add the tool count to the working line

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Play a sound when Claude is done, needs you, or fails

autoSaveAt.title: Auto-save at %
autoSaveAt.description: At this context fill Claude saves the state (memory or HANDOFF.md), then the conversation is cleared or compacted; 0 is off

autoSaveMode.title: Auto-save: then
autoSaveMode.description: What follows the save: clear (empty context, memory reloads) or compact (a summary stays)

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Say when Claude is done, needs you or fails; warn before the cache lapses and at 90% of the 5h limit
